SELECT c.* FROM data_collection c JOIN data_generation g ON g.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND g.collection_id = c.id AND g.generation = c.active_generation WHERE c.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND c.resource_id = #{resource} AND c.status = 'active' AND g.source_hash = #{sourceHash} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM data_field f WHERE f.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND f.collection_id = c.id AND f.generation = c.active_generation AND f.readable = TRUE) AND (c.updated_at < #{position.time} OR (c.updated_at = #{position.time} AND c.id < #{position.id}))
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM data_collection WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
